methodology: All non-README Markdown pages under src/rlink/community, src/rlink/game and src/aoe are indexed.
Declared routes/methods come only from explicit HTTP-method headings. Unqualified headings remain fragments, not synthesized request URLs.
heading-or-short-placeholder means fewer than 100 non-heading characters. Explicit parameter templates without a parameter table are flagged separately.
parameter_names_in_wiki records table field names before the first Response heading; it is not a complete required/optional schema.
Catalog matching ignores casing and trailing slashes solely for source cross-references, not to assert runtime equivalence.
Source-only game routes were added without network execution. Existing probe evidence remains unchanged.

documentation_gaps: Example and OpenAPI use profileNames; wiki parameter table uses profile_names.
